title: The Woman Who Did
author: Grant Allen
description: "The Woman Who Did" by Grant Allen is a novel published in 1895.
longDescription: It follows Herminia Barton, a Cambridge-educated woman who deliberately chooses to live with the man she loves without marriage, challenging Victorian social conventions.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Grant Blairfindie Allen was a Canadian science writer and novelist, educated in England. He was a public promoter of evolution in the second half of the nineteenth century.
